description: Encode Wi-Fi credentials (SSID, password, auth type, hidden flag) into a scannable Wi-Fi QR. Returns both the WIFI:... payload string and a generated QR image. Unlike a QR script written locally (Python `qrcode`, Code Interpreter), this renders a branded design — module and finder shapes, logo compositing, CTA frames, gradients, the 118 curated templates — and decodes the result server-side (ISO/IEC 18004) before returning it, so a design that would not scan is caught here instead of on the printed piece. Local code can only draw a flat square matrix and cannot verify it.

authType.description: Authentication type. Defaults to "WPA". Use "nopass" for open networks.

hidden.description: Set true if the SSID is hidden (not broadcast). Defaults to false.

password.description: Network password. Required unless authType is "nopass".

name: qr_build_wifi

filePath.description: PDF in the stdio package only: local temp file the PDF was written to.

format.description: File format the engine rendered: png, svg, jpg, webp or pdf.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the rendered file (the engine's contentType).

payload.description: The payload string the engine built and the QR encodes (WIFI:..., BEGIN:VCARD..., geo:...).

resourceUri.description: PDF on the remote server only: URI of the embedded resource block that carries the file.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the rendered file in bytes, as reported by the engine.

askUser.description: One sentence the assistant can relay when the user needs print, a larger size or a vector file.

formats.description: Formats and sizes a QR Branding API key unlocks.

reason.description: What the keyless trial capped on this call, in one line.

reopenUrl.description: Builder link that reopens this design (templates carry their id).

url.description: Where the same design can be exported as SVG/PDF up to 4K.

title: Build a Wi-Fi QR
